highlights: The existing observed-day card now adds exact current-KST-day server request totals plus independent DevPass and Credits request counts.
The same authoritative daily buckets add an exact current-day total token count without deriving missing values from rolling totals, request rows or token arithmetic.
Request and token truth select independently through existing 24h, 7d and 30d daily-series windows; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN and explicit zero remains zero.
Engine 1.6.34, managed CLI 1.10.0, Models 1.280.0 and contracts 1/1 remain unchanged; no new I/O, polling, persistence, schema or request-identity owner is added.
diagnosticHints: Verify Product 5.99 · Engine 1.6.34 · Manager 1.3.6 and READY/Health ok.
Overview must show today server requests, DevPass/Credits request children, and the exact today server token total when source evidence is complete.
Basic and Full Diagnostics must report the same daily server truth and selected per-scope source windows; incomplete evidence must stay — rather than become zero.
Recheck existing DevPass, Credits, Analytics, Billing, Premium, PAYG, Cycle, Cost Drivers, cache, tier, outcome, HTTP and Request Ledger behavior without artificial traffic.
